semiconductor_relevance: High — Oricus Semicon Solutions specializes in manufacturing bespoke tooling solutions for the semiconductor assembly and test industry.
summary: Oricus Semicon Solutions is a manufacturer of customized semiconductor backend tools, providing precision tooling solutions for assembly and test applications. They offer both one-off and high-volume production capabilities, focusing on high-temperature resistant tools and complex tools for advanced packaging.

High temperature resistant tools for power devices
Micro precision tooling for advanced packaging
